units.source_text: （她的那双眼，活像男人的眼睛。

en.t: Her eyes look just like a man's eyes.

units.source_text: 是一位具有良好教养的千金呀！

en.t: She is truly a well-bred young lady from a good family!

units.source_text: 我是否应该明确地告诉她呢？

en.t: The dog-shop owner ought to say something!

units.source_text: 我们家小宠犬那样的脑袋是俄国狼狗型的，是英国新型的上等优良品种呢。

en.t: A head like our little pet dog's is the Russian wolfhound type, a new English style of superior, fine breeding.

units.source_text: 小姐的狗那张脸是美国型的。

en.t: The young lady's dog has an American-style face.

units.source_text: 她多么具有贵族小姐的气派呀。）

en.t: How very much she has the air of an aristocratic young lady.)

units.source_text: 夫人一边想一边说：“真不愧是硬毛小猎狗，这狗毛长得真好。

en.t: Thinking this, the lady said, "It really is a fine wire-haired little hunting dog; its coat has grown beautifully.

units.source_text: 既洁白又漂亮，还十分精心地修剪过。

en.t: It is white and lovely, and it has been trimmed with great care.

units.source_text: 它的毛是用理发推子推的吧？”

en.t: Its fur was clipped with barber's clippers, wasn't it?"

units.source_text: （可不是嘛，多亏蹲坐着，那姿势着实难以启齿恭维嘛。）

en.t: (Of course; thanks to the way it was crouching, that posture was truly hard to praise aloud.)
